attorneys: John H. Benckenstein for petitioner, and Joe H. Tonahill for respondent in No. 317., Reo Knowles for petitioner, and William, Vandercreek and Marvin Jones for respondent in No. 318. Josh Groce for petitioner, and Rudy Rice and William Vandercreek for respondent in No. 319.
